description: This file defines the 'InterestMethod' enumeration used to represent different interest calculation methods within the loan product domain of the Fineract project.

classes.name: InterestMethod
classes.description: An enum that specifies different interest calculation methods, including DECLINING_BALANCE, FLAT, and INVALID, with associated properties and utility methods.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the interest method.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the interest method.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer to its corresponding InterestMethod enum value, defaulting to INVALID if no match is found.

methods.name: isDecliningBalance
methods.description: Checks if the interest method is DECLINING_BALANCE.

methods.name: isFlat
methods.description: Checks if the interest method is FLAT.
